ÁREA ATTRIBUTION VERIFIED: metadata.area credits 'Literaturas Extranjeras y Comparadas' to the parent's plan 2023 and explicitly says the program itself consigns neither área nor ciclo (true — no such string in the PDF). /Users/tomb/p/learn/nodes/uba.ffyl.letras.json L106 carries the group 'Área · Literaturas Extranjeras y Comparadas' and L132 lists this exact address inside it, role 'cuatrimestral' (consistent); the parent's frame (L66) states the área grouping comes from the plan-2023 resolution ACS-2023-58. Attribution stands and is disclosed.

5. EXCLUSIONS — applied consistently, no counterexample found. All six named journal/anuario items are genuinely journal articles and genuinely undrawn: Catanorchi Rinascimento (L168), Simoncini Rinascimento (L197), Perino Studia Aurea (L183), Sverlij Studia Aurea (L186), Vázquez de Parga (L220), Ginzburg (L255), Houppert (L260), Ciordia Anuario Argentino de Germanística V (L309). The two Beolco Diálogos (L241-244) are ficha-only with no volume — correctly undrawn. No complementaria or bibliografía-general item leaked into the exits (spot-checked Burke El sentido del pasado, Celenza, Hale, Kristeller, Duby, Ficino, Niccoli, Plebani, Camporesi, Fevbre, Fido, Rinesi, Tillyard, Bouwsma, Greenblatt, Navarro, Pérez Gallego, Warburg, Panofsky, Curtius, Foucault — none appear). The inverse also holds: the ficha-de-cátedra translations whose parent volume IS published are drawn as the volume (Dotti, Greene, Garin/Storia, Marsh, Bullegas, Luciani, Paolucci, Raimondi, Screech, Puliafito) — consistent with the stated rule.

6. ERRATA LIST — all 11 registered contradictions independently confirmed true: (1) L122 vs L305; (2) L273 vs L275; (3) L159 vs L206; (4) L137/L289 Heller vs L212/L371 Garin, and L212 prints 'El hombre de Renacimiento'; (5) L251-252 = L282-283; (6) L169 '137-177' vs L358 '1137-177'; (7) L174-175; (8) L332-335 both vols subtitled 'hasta el siglo XIV'; (9) Adagios named at L101, absent from U4 Fuentes; (10) 'Ludovico Arisoto' L103, 'sine nomine' L108 vs 'sin nombre' L297; (11) 'a. Bibliografía' at L110 after 'c. Contenidos' L86, and 'Bibliografía general' doubled L328-329.

MINOR IMPERFECTIONS (none rise to a factual error): (a) frame says the obligatoria is labelled 'Bibliografía crítica' in U1-U3 and 'Bibliografía obligatoria' in U4-U5 — true, but it does not mention that U1 uniquely carries an umbrella 'Bibliografía obligatoria' header (L113) above both '-Fuentes' and '-Bibliografía crítica'. (b) Silent normalizations not registered among the errata: 'Emece'→'Emecé' (L262), 'Lòpez Arriazu'/'Rodrìguez'→'López'/'Rodríguez' (L238), and the original's 'Mimesis' (L122) vs 'Mímesis' (L305) inconsistency is unremarked (errata 1 flags only the author-name variant). (c) 'capitolo sesto, VI-IX' (L172) is rendered 'cap. VI, VI-IX' — an interpretation of 'sesto', not a literal transcription. (d) lede's 'El eje es el hombre doble' slightly upgrades the program's 'será un punto de partida insoslayable' (L61-62). (e) equipoDocente includes SFORZA, who in the PDF sits above the 'EQUIPO DOCENTE:' block (L35 vs L37) — mitigated by the '(profesora a cargo)' qualifier. (f) Magnavacca's 'Estudio preliminar' (a U2 crítica entry, L178) is folded into the Pico exit whose role reads 'fuente · Unidad 2'; the study is named in the title so nothing is lost, but the role does not signal the crítica listing.

STRUCTURAL NOTE (systemic, not a defect of this node): none of the 57 child addresses have node files on disk. This is the atlas-wide L2 convention — no course node in nodes/ has any child file — and the books group note declares 'No indexados aún como libros (L3)'. The spine note ('Cada unidad del programa 2026 es un nodo, en orden.') reads slightly as if the unit nodes were already drawn.

CONCLUSION: I could not refute a single unit, book, metadata field, resolution number, code, hour count, cátedra name, exclusion, or errata claim. This node is unusually tight — the merge rule, the exclusion policy, and the errata register are all applied without a counterexample.
